stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.meaningZh: 舌；语言能力；讲话方式；语言
items.sentenceEn: The doctor asked him to hold his tongue still.
items.sentenceZh: 医生让他保持舌头不动。
items.scene: In a bright clinic, an adult patient opens his mouth while a doctor uses a small examination light and gestures gently for the visible tongue to remain still.
items.altText: 诊室里，医生用检查灯观察病人的舌头。

items.sentenceEn: The new driver received her license after passing the test.
items.sentenceZh: 新司机通过考试后拿到了驾照。
items.scene: A pleased adult driver receives a small official card from an examiner beside a parked practice car, with a completed driving course visible behind them but no readable writing.
items.altText: 通过考试后，新司机从考官手中接过驾照。

items.sentenceEn: The old round house gave the hikers shelter from the storm.
items.sentenceZh: 古老的圆形土楼为徒步者遮挡了暴风雨。
items.scene: During heavy rain in Fujian hills, two wet adult hikers hurry through the open gate of a warm glowing tulou while wind and rain remain outside its thick walls.
items.altText: 暴雨中，两名徒步者进入福建土楼躲避风雨。

items.sentenceEn: She rubbed the cold window until a clear circle appeared.
items.sentenceZh: 她擦拭冰冷的窗户，直到出现一个清晰的圆圈。
items.scene: An adult traveler uses a gloved palm to rub condensation from a train window, creating one transparent circular patch amid the fogged glass and revealing snowy scenery beyond.
items.altText: 旅客擦去车窗上的雾气，露出一个清晰圆圈。

items.sentenceEn: The plan sparked controversy among the town's residents.
items.sentenceZh: 这项计划在镇上居民中引发了争议。
items.scene: At a public meeting, two balanced groups of adults respond differently to the same model of a proposed tower, some approving and others objecting with expressive but respectful gestures.
items.altText: 居民围绕同一座建筑方案模型表达不同意见。

items.sentenceEn: A moon gate marks the entrance to the garden.
items.sentenceZh: 一道月亮门标示着花园的入口。
items.scene: A circular moon gate in a Suzhou garden clearly frames the path from an outer stone courtyard into a lush inner garden of bamboo, rocks and a small pavilion.
items.altText: 苏州园林的月亮门构成通往内园的入口。

items.sentenceEn: The climber checked that every rope was properly secured.
items.sentenceZh: 攀登者检查每根绳索是否都已正确固定。
items.scene: An experienced adult climber inspects three ropes, each correctly threaded through a secure anchor, while a partner watches; the focus is on careful hand placement and safe preparation.
items.altText: 攀登者仔细检查固定在锚点上的三根绳索。

items.sentenceEn: The bright mural will fade after years of sun and rain.
items.sentenceZh: 这幅鲜艳的壁画经过多年日晒雨淋后会褪色。
items.scene: One long outdoor mural transitions visually from vivid fresh colors on the sheltered end to pale weathered colors on the exposed end beneath sun and rain symbols without text.
items.altText: 户外壁画从鲜艳逐渐变为日晒雨淋后的浅淡颜色。

items.sentenceEn: The goalkeeper took a defensive position in front of the net.
items.sentenceZh: 守门员在球门前采取了防守姿势。
items.scene: A focused adult goalkeeper plants both feet and spreads ready arms directly before a football goal as an opposing player approaches from a safe distance.
items.altText: 守门员站在球门前摆出明确的防守姿势。

items.sentenceEn: The community planted a memorial tree after the tragedy.
items.sentenceZh: 悲剧发生后，社区种下了一棵纪念树。
items.scene: A diverse community quietly gathers around a newly planted tree with small unmarked stones at its base, expressing shared grief and care without depicting the harmful event itself.
items.altText: 社区居民围绕纪念树默哀，表达共同的悲痛。

items.sentenceEn: The fisherman lifted a silver fish from the net.
items.sentenceZh: 渔民从渔网中提起一条银色的鱼。
items.scene: At dawn on a calm Chinese river, an adult fisherman in a small wooden boat lifts a woven net containing one clearly visible silver fish, with distant karst hills reflected in water.
items.altText: 清晨的河上，渔民从网中提起一条银色鱼。

items.sentenceEn: Tall windows and open shelves characterize the new library.
items.sentenceZh: 高窗和开放式书架是这座新图书馆的特征。
items.scene: A modern library interior prominently repeats tall sunlit windows and accessible open shelves, with visitors using the space and those two design traits clearly dominating the architecture.
items.altText: 高大的窗户和开放式书架构成新图书馆的主要特色。

items.sentenceEn: Friends carried white flowers to the funeral.
items.sentenceZh: 朋友们带着白花参加葬礼。
items.scene: Adults in respectful dark clothing carry white chrysanthemums into a quiet Chinese memorial hall, where a simple flower arrangement and warm candlelike light convey remembrance without showing a body.
items.altText: 朋友们手持白菊走进安静的中式追思厅参加葬礼。

items.sentenceEn: Teaching became her profession after years of study.
items.sentenceZh: 经过多年学习，教学成为了她的职业。
items.scene: An adult teacher confidently guides a classroom activity while a subtle background sequence shows her earlier years studying and practicing, ending at her present professional role.
items.altText: 一名教师在多年学习后走上讲台，从事教学职业。

items.sentenceEn: Moving one wall will alter the shape of the room.
items.sentenceZh: 移动一面墙会改变房间的形状。
items.scene: A designer slides one lightweight partition in a model room; the floor area visibly changes from a narrow rectangle on one side to a wider shape on the other.
items.altText: 设计师移动隔墙，使房间的空间形状发生改变。

items.sentenceEn: Five colored pieces constitute the complete star.
items.sentenceZh: 五块彩色拼片组成了完整的星形。
items.scene: Exactly five distinct colored paper pieces fit together edge to edge to form one complete large star, with no extra pieces and clear seams showing the whole is composed of parts.
items.altText: 五块不同颜色的拼片共同组成一颗完整的星。

items.sentenceEn: The establishment of the clinic brought care closer to the village.
items.sentenceZh: 诊所的建立让村民更容易获得医疗照护。
items.scene: Villagers gather happily as a newly completed rural Chinese clinic opens beside their homes, with a visual progression from construction materials to a welcoming functioning building.
items.altText: 中国乡村新诊所建成开放，为附近村民提供医疗服务。

items.sentenceEn: She squeezed the lemon until juice filled the small bowl.
items.sentenceZh: 她挤压柠檬，直到果汁流进小碗。
items.scene: A close view of adult hands firmly squeezing one lemon half above a ceramic bowl as bright drops and a thin stream collect below, with the compressed fruit visibly changing shape.
items.altText: 双手挤压半个柠檬，果汁滴入下方的小碗。

items.sentenceEn: Her imagination turned one ink drop into an entire mountain world.
items.sentenceZh: 她的想象力把一滴墨变成了整片山水世界。
items.scene: A young adult artist watches one drop of ink spread from her brush across rice paper and transform into a vast fantastical Chinese mountain landscape with cranes, waterfalls and mist.
items.altText: 画家的想象力让一滴墨在宣纸上化成山水世界。

items.meaningZh: 面具；口罩；掩饰；掩码（计算机）
items.sentenceEn: The welder lowered her protective mask before the sparks appeared.
items.sentenceZh: 火花出现前，焊工放下了防护面罩。
items.scene: In a safe workshop sequence, an adult welder first lowers a dark protective face mask and then begins welding as sparks scatter away, emphasizing the protective barrier before action.
items.altText: 焊工在火花出现前先放下防护面罩。
